```
Fix FFI build on macOS 27: don't strip host proc-macros

On macOS 27.0.1, scripts/build-ffi.sh fails in a fresh target directory
with "can't find crate for thiserror_impl". dyld refuses to load every
host proc-macro dylib: "mis-aligned LINKEDIT string pool".

The script exports MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=14.0, which also reaches
host proc-macros and build scripts. At a 14.0 floor the linker writes
chained fixups. rustc then strips release dylibs with its bundled
rust-objcopy, which leaves the string table 4-byte aligned, and
macOS 27.0.1 rejects that. The same dylib loads when left unstripped
or stripped with /usr/bin/strip. SDKROOT has no effect.

Set CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_BUILD_OVERRIDE_STRIP=false so host artifacts
skip the strip pass. Scoping the deployment target to the two cross
targets is not an option: rustc reads it only from the environment, so
RUSTFLAGS or a link argument cannot do it.

The shipped static library is unchanged, and every object in it still
targets macOS 14.0 on both architectures.
```
